However, the claim states she was president of "the University of Texas System," which is a broader system that includes multiple institutions. The passages do not confirm she was president of the entire University of Texas System - only of the Austin campus.

The core issue is whether the claim's attribution of these individuals to "the University of Texas System" is factually accurate or represents a category error by overgeneralizing campus-specific roles to system-level positions.

The critical issue is that the claim conflates the University of Texas System (a multi-campus system) with the University of Texas at Austin (the flagship campus). The passages clearly indicate these are distinct entities, though UT Austin is the flagship of the system.
